title: PMS-STRATA Transformation Record
description: Structural schema for one PMS-STRATA operation occurrence or integrated chain record. Schema validity does not establish substantive admissibility, truth, causality, semantic validity, legitimacy, diagnosis, or application authority.

openControlledTerm.description: Open controlled term. Extension values require an explicit control source and rationale.

composeDetails.description: COMPOSE declaration. Selection Rule and target identity/type are authoritative at the referenced top-level paths.

decomposeDetails.description: DECOMPOSE declaration. Source identity/type and target granularity are authoritative at top-level paths; Resolution and source-function outcomes are authoritative in result fields.

projectAsDetails.description: PROJECT_AS declaration. Source identity/type, target identity/frame, validity scope, and contextual target function are authoritative at referenced top-level paths.

chainDeclaration.description: Integrated chain declaration. A chain is not an operation type; cross-record length and reference integrity require package-level validation.

rule_assessment_pointers.description: Exact principal Rule IDs for this audit stage. Repeated Rule IDs across stages represent distinct declared assessment modes, not duplicate independent tests.

admissibilityDeclaration.description: Twelve-stage audit plus sixteen Rule assessments. Presence and formal completion do not establish substantive passage.

alternativesDeclaration.description: Alternative disclosure requires at least one actual alternative/no-transformation entry or an explicit reasoned negative finding.

additional_affected_claim_ids.description: Only genuinely distinct additional claims. The current tested claim is represented authoritatively by current_claim_pointer.

statusDeclaration.description: Support, resolution, capture, and evidence axes. Claim disposition is authoritative in routing and referenced here by a fixed JSON Pointer.

splitDecision.description: Split decision rationale. Separated claim/record IDs are authoritative in the candidate assessments marked split_to_separate_claim.

routedResult.description: Final routed result. Candidate generation, rejection, split handling, and selection are held in one authoritative class-indexed assessment object.

resultDeclaration.description: Operation-specific result, status axes, final route, and class-specific payload remain distinct.

candidateAssessment.description: Single authoritative assessment for one canonical class in the current delimited claim routing packet.

candidateAssessments.description: Exactly one assessment slot per canonical class. This replaces disconnected candidate, rationale, and rejection lists.

boundaryAdjudication.description: Candidate-local adjudication. Current load-bearing boundary IDs are valid only for their controlled class pair; new collisions require an explicit extension record.

x-pms-strata-artifact.registered_scope: record field syntax, requiredness, conditional payloads, occurrence/chain discrimination, routed/diagnostic discrimination, exact audit-stage Rule bindings, authoritative-axis pointers, candidate-boundary adjudication consistency, current-claim pointers, and structural cross-field consistency
cross_record_integrity_checks: referenced claim and record IDs exist
chain reference count matches declared operation sequence
claim and record relation graphs are acyclic
source and target object IDs agree across linked records

may_validate: fixed pointers to authoritative duplicate-prone axes
candidate-local boundary pair validity and split ownership
